journey.name: pair primary node
journey.description: Proves the primary node can be seen, changed and reset in Settings, and that a failed pairing keeps the previous primary. Precondition: see README.md; a fresh wallet with no channel, so changing the primary is allowed.

actions.action: Open Settings, the Advanced tab, and tap "Primary node" (testTag "PrimaryNodeSettings")
Verify "PrimaryNodeCurrent" shows the default primary URI and "PrimaryNodeOnline" is shown
Clear "PrimaryNodeInput", type a valid public key with an unreachable address such as 127.0.0.1:1, and tap "PrimaryNodeConnect"
Verify "PrimaryNodeError" says the primary node is offline or unreachable, and "PrimaryNodeCurrent" still shows the default primary
Type "not a node" into "PrimaryNodeInput" and tap "PrimaryNodeConnect"
Verify "PrimaryNodeError" asks for a valid node public key or URI
Verify the "Primary node connected" toast and "PrimaryNodeOnline"
